mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_domains wd ON w.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON w.workspace_id = wm.workspace_id JOIN members m ON wm.member_id = m.member_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND w.status IN (0, 1) AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm."LEFT" IS NULL AND m.status = 0

SELECT p.project_id projectId, p.subject, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') startAt, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') endAt FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND pm."LEFT" IS NULL AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm."LEFT" IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workId} AND p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND pm."LEFT" IS NULL AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm."LEFT" IS NULL

SELECT pm.project_member_id projectMemberId, md.name, pm.role FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN members m ON wm.member_id = m.member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.status = 0 AND pm."LEFT" IS NULL AND wm.workspace_id = #{workId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm."LEFT" IS NULL AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY pm.role DESC, md.name ASC

SELECT t.task_id taskId, t.project_member_id projectMemberId, t.title, t.status, md.name assigneeName FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON t.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY t.task_id

SELECT st.sub_task_id subTaskId, st.task_id parentTaskId, st.project_member_id projectMemberId, st.title, st.status, md.name assigneeName FROM sub_tasks st JOIN tasks t ON st.task_id = t.task_id LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON st.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE st.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL AND st.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY st.task_id, st.sub_task_id

SELECT tm.project_member_id projectMemberId, t.task_id taskId, t.title FROM task_members tm JOIN tasks t ON tm.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY t.task_id

SELECT sm.project_member_id projectMemberId, st.sub_task_id subTaskId, st.title FROM sub_task_members sm JOIN sub_tasks st ON sm.sub_task_id = st.sub_task_id JOIN tasks t ON st.task_id = t.task_id WHERE st.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL AND st.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY st.sub_task_id
